notes.title: POGOPPL is out now on Steam!
notes.notes:
Go solo or bring your friends as you hit the streets of Pogo City in this physics-based pogo stick platformer. Let’s bounce!

[previewyoutube=t_fE9ej9DHI;full][/previewyoutube]

Take on a unique challenge in this physics-based pogo stick platformer! Join an ever expanding gang of POGOPPL as you bounce through the sunny streets of Pogo City. Although it was built to be a haven for pogo-enthusiasts, lately things in Pogo City have taken a dark turn. Laser barriers and obstacles of all kinds are being deployed to eradicate pogo activity in the city. So hop on your pogo stick, solo or with friends, and uncover this diabolical plot!

JOIN THE POGOPPL, AND TAKE BACK POGO CITY!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1640220/POGOPPL/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41211008/3aa866cc266e9b1ff00eea42b0da51670f6b9401.gif[/img]

The tale of Crossing Guard Joe continues in POGOPPL!
